summary: Independent audit found the recovery contract read-only and dry-run by construction. The endpoint is GET-only, UI rendering is renderer-only, readonly source failure blocks status, and rollback/process-kill/Original Codex profile touch are not claimed or executable.

evidence.finding: build_custom_recovery_contract_packet hardcodes contract_endpoint_mutation_allowed=false, recovery_live_ready=false, operator_ready_claimed=false, rollback_claimed=false, process_kill_claimed=false, browser_payload_allowed=false, and blocks when readonly_sources_ok is false.
GET handler exposes /api/codex/custom/recovery/contract; POST handler has no matching recovery-contract route.
UI fetch helper is GET-only with no method or body for contract fetch.
Tests assert dry-run-only behavior and blocked status on readonly failure.
Live-server tests assert false readiness flags, browser payload rejection, and readonly-failure blocking.
UI tests assert renderer-only contract surface and absence of POST recovery contract path.

auditor_commands.command: python3 -m py_compile wild_boar_proxy/codex_recovery_contract.py tests/test_codex_recovery_contract.py wild_boar_proxy/web_design_live_server.py tests/test_web_design_live_server.py tests/test_web_design_ui.py

auditor_environment_limitations: Auditor's plain python could not run live-server/UI tests because _tkinter/PIL were unavailable.
Main orchestrator reran those tests with the bundled Python runtime and they passed.
